# homebrew problems

Silence the completion-security warning that every zsh printed after installing Homebrew:

```
zsh compinit: insecure directories, run compaudit for list.
```

Homebrew's `share/zsh` directories are group-writable by the `admin` group; `compinit` refuses to load completion functions from directories another user could write to and prints this line on every shell start until the permissions are tightened.

Expected: the installer fixes the permissions so that `compinit` is quiet from the first shell.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/206#issuecomment-5711690579
Code vs intent: the closing `compaudit | xargs chmod g-w,o-w` in `install` is annotated "not tested"; `compaudit` exists only inside zsh, so in this bash script the pipeline fails and, with `set -e`, marks every installation as failed. The permission fix that actually works is the earlier `chmod -R go-w "$(brew --prefix)/share/zsh"`.
-->
